CounterOS — Retailer App Flow

Low-fidelity flow reference built from the original screen designs, for dev hand-off. Screens are grouped by journey phase in the order a first-time retailer moves through them, with build notes under each screen.
SOURCE: Retailer First User Journey22 screens · 7 phasesGrayscale = reference only, not final visual design
Screen ID matches original filename Green bullets = build / logic notes for developer → = user action moves to next screen in row
00 · Entry01 · Onboarding02 · Home / Dashboard03 · Add Inventory04 · Sell a Product05 · Insights & Stock06 · Rewards & Wallet07 · Restock from Distributor
00 Entry

First screen on app open. Routes returning users to login and first-timers into onboarding.

R1 Splash / Auth Choice
  • Hero card shows live cashback + rewards preview (marketing, not functional data)
  • “New User” → goes to RL1 (Mobile Number)
  • “Existing User” → goes to a login flow (not included in this batch — confirm with design if it reuses RL1/RL2)
01 Onboarding

New-user setup, 4 steps. Progress bar at top of each step screen (Step 1 of 4 → 4 of 4).

RL1 Mobile Number
  • Single field: 10-digit mobile number, +91 prefix locked
  • “Continue securely” triggers OTP send → RL2
→
RL2 OTP Verification
  • 4-digit OTP auto-boxes, resend logic needed
  • Shows masked destination number for confirmation
  • “Developer Demo: 1234” bypass code visible — strip before prod build
  • Success → RL3 Shop Setup (Step 1 of 4)
→
RL3 Shop Setup — Step 1 of 4
  • Fields: Shop/Trade name, Owner name, GST (optional), Business category (single-select tile grid), Shop location
  • Location: auto-detect via device GPS, shows “Location Detected✓” chip with Clear option
  • Category choice likely drives which distributors/products show later
  • “Continue to Distributors” → RL4
→
RL4 Link Distributors — Step 2 of 4
  • Search bar + list of nearby distributors (name, city, distance, rating, categories they supply)
  • Each row has independent “+ Link” action — multi-select, not single choice
  • Copy states this unlocks Purchase Cashback on invoice uploads — confirm this is a backend flag set per linked distributor
  • “Continue to Payout Setup” → RL5 (should be reachable even with 0 linked, i.e. skippable?)
→
RL5 Payout Setup — Step 3 of 4
  • 3 payout method options: Mobile Number, UPI ID (0% fee, shown pre-selected), Bank Account
  • Conditional field: UPI ID input appears when UPI selected
  • Verification note: ₹1 test transfer before first withdrawal — needs payout-gateway hook
  • “Skip for later” exists — confirm wallet stays locked/read-only until payout method is set
  • “Finish Setup” → RL6
→
RL6 Setup Complete — Step 4 of 4
  • Confirmation state + personalised message from “CounterOS Assistant” referencing the user's name, tier and category
  • Chips show category (“AGRI”) and distributors linked (“0 linked”) pulled from prior steps
  • “Take me to Dashboard” → RL7 (Home)
02 Home / Dashboard

Main landing screen after login. Hub for the 3 core actions and bottom tab navigation used throughout the app.

RL7 Home — Dashboard
  • Top bar: avatar, greeting + location, AI assistant shortcut, notifications (with badge count), theme toggle, settings
  • Wallet balance card with eye icon (show/hide balance) and “+ Add Money”
  • Rewards Unlocked strip: this-month total, Gold Tier badge, cashback vs sale-reward split
  • 3 primary actions: Add to Inventory, Sell a Product, Order from Distributor
  • Secondary shortcuts: Earnings, Stock, Assistant, Settings
  • Weekly Earnings bar chart, Purchase vs Sale legend — needs real chart component (interactive tooltip per bar recommended)
  • Bottom nav (persists app-wide): Home, Invoice, Sell, Cart, Earnings, Stock — Cart shows live item-count badge
03 Add Inventory

3 ways to add stock, as tabs on one screen. Reached from Home → “Add to Inventory” or bottom-nav “Invoice.”

RL8 Add Inventory — Manual tab
  • 3 tabs at top: Scan / Invoice / Manual (Manual shown, active)
  • Warning banner: manually-added products do NOT earn scan rewards — must be enforced server-side, not just UI copy
  • Form fields: Product name (searchable dropdown against a common-products catalog), Category, Unit, Quantity, Purchase price, Selling price, Mfg date, Exp date
  • “Add to Inventory” → back to Stock Ledger (RL16) with new item
→
RL9 Add Inventory — Invoice tab
  • File-picker style upload card for a PDF invoice
  • “Try with Demo generated invoice” — sample/test path, likely needs OCR/parsing service behind it to extract line items
  • This is also the flow tied to “Purchase Cashback” promised in onboarding — confirm cashback is calculated from parsed invoice value
→
RL10 Add Inventory — Scan tab
  • Live camera viewfinder with barcode targeting frame
  • “Simulate Scan for Demo” button — keep only in dev/test builds
  • Goal: pre-fill the Manual form (RL8) fields from the scanned barcode, then user confirms/edits
04 Sell a Product

2 ways to build a sale, shared cart + checkout + OTP confirmation. Reached from Home → “Sell a Product” or bottom-nav “Sell.”

RL11 Sell — Scan & Sell tab (empty cart)
  • 2 tabs: Scan & Sell (active) / Manual Select
  • Camera viewfinder identical pattern to RL10, plus “Simulate Scan” for demo
  • Cart panel pinned below scanner, starts at “Cart (0 items)”
  • Sticky bottom bar: “Earn ₹X on this sale” + “Proceed to Checkout” (disabled while cart is empty)
→
RL11-1 Sell — Scan & Sell tab (item scanned)
  • Same screen as RL11 after a successful scan: cart updates to “Cart (1 items)” with live line item + total
  • Floating cart icon (bottom-right) also shows the item-count badge, mirrors bottom-nav Cart badge
  • Reward line updates live: “Earn ₹60 on this sale”
  • “Proceed to Checkout” → RL13 (Cart detail)
→
RL12 Sell — Manual Select tab
  • Lists current stock (from Inventory) as sellable rows: name, pack size, stock left, price, reward earned per item
  • Tapping a row adds it to the same cart used by Scan & Sell (state is shared across tabs)
  • Cart summary + “Earn ₹X” + Checkout bar identical component to RL11 — build as one shared component
→
RL13 Cart Detail
  • Per-line quantity stepper (− / +), remove item (×)
  • Customer Details form: Customer name, WhatsApp number — required, copy states OTP will be sent here
  • Footer shows reward preview (“You will earn ₹65 on this sale”) above the amount-aware “Checkout · ₹380” CTA
  • “Checkout” → triggers OTP send → RL14
→
RL14 Verify Sale — OTP
  • Modal/sheet over current screen, not a full page
  • OTP sent to the customer's WhatsApp number captured in RL13, 4-digit input
  • Demo OTP shown for test builds only — remove for production
  • “Verify & Complete” finalises the sale, deducts stock, credits reward to wallet, clears cart; “Cancel” returns to Cart
05 Insights & Stock

Extended Home state plus the full Stock Ledger, reached via bottom-nav “Stock” or Home shortcuts.

RL15 Home — Daily Insight + Activity
  • Same Home shell as RL7, scrolled down: adds an AI-generated “Daily Insight” card (stock health, low-liquidity alert, category strategy tip)
  • Copy is templated with markdown-style bold emphasis — confirm whether this is a live LLM call or a rules-based template
  • “Day's Activity” feed below: recent sales with relative amounts and a “All →” link to full history
→
RL16 Stock Ledger
  • Header: product count + primary category, quick-add and quick-sell icon shortcuts, notifications, logout
  • Search bar + horizontally scrollable category filter chips (All, Fertilizers, Seeds, Pesticides, Chemicals, …)
  • Two shortcut buttons feed directly into RL10 (Scan Barcode) and RL9 (Upload Invoice)
  • Each product row: stock bar (visual level), sell price, reward earned, buy price, stock count, low-stock warning icon (see “Jain Agro Chemicals – 3 in stock ⚠️”)
06 Rewards & Wallet

Earnings breakdown and payout management, reached via Home → Earnings shortcut or the wallet balance card.

RL17 Home — Wallet & Rewards summary
  • Highlighted wallet card: balance, “+ Add Money”, Rewards Unlocked this month, tier badge, cashback vs sale-reward split — tapping likely opens RL18
  • Rest of screen reuses the standard Home layout (quick actions, shortcuts, weekly chart)
→
RL18 Wallet — Balance & History
  • Full-screen wallet view: Total Balance, “Add” and “Withdraw” primary actions (Withdraw should route into the payout method set in RL5)
  • Wallet History list, filterable by period (“Last 30 days” shown), one row per transaction with source and amount
  • All rows shown are sale-reward credits in this sample — confirm purchase-cashback and manual withdrawals also render here with a type indicator
07 Restock from Distributor

Ordering flow for wholesale restock, reached from Home → “Order from Distributor.”

RL19 Home — entry point
  • Same Home shell; the “Order from Distributor” card is the entry point highlighted here
  • Only distributors linked back in onboarding (RL4) should be orderable from here
→
RL20 Order from Distributor
  • Distributor picker (dropdown, defaults to a linked distributor) + product-category filter
  • Product catalog rows with “+” quick add, price shown per pack
  • “My Order History” shows past orders with status chip (e.g. “Pending Approval”) — needs distributor-side approval step in backend
  • Sticky “Place Order · ₹X” footer, totals update as items are added
